titleEn: Longest Arithmetic Subsequence of Given Difference
title: 最长定差子序列
summary: 求数组中相邻差恒等于 difference 的最长子序列长度。
insight: 按原顺序扫描 value，以它结尾的最长长度只能接在值 value-difference 的已有子序列之后；哈希表直接保存每个结尾值的最优长度。
pitfalls: 同一结尾值重复出现时保留较大长度

solutions.title: 结尾值哈希动态规划
solutions.idea: 由唯一所需前驱值转移当前长度。
steps: dp 映射结尾值到最长长度，answer=0
dp[value]=max(dp[value],length)，同步更新 answer，返回 answer

code.java: class Solution { public int longestSubsequence(int[] arr,int difference){Map<Integer,Integer> dp=new HashMap<>();int answer=0;for(int value:arr){int length=dp.getOrDefault(value-difference,0)+1;dp.put(value,Math.max(dp.getOrDefault(value,0),length));answer=Math.max(answer,length);}return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun longestSubsequence(arr:IntArray,difference:Int):Int{val dp=mutableMapOf<Int,Int>();var answer=0;for(value in arr){val length=(dp[value-difference]?:0)+1;dp[value]=maxOf(dp[value]?:0,length);answer=maxOf(answer,length)};return answer} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: int longestSubsequence(vector<int>& arr,int difference){unordered_map<int,int> dp;int answer=0;for(int value:arr){int length=dp[value-difference]+1;dp[value]=max(dp[value],length);answer=max(answer,length);}return answer;} };
